description: Confirmed the boat, and called the house quiet enough to play in.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Itemised the flag, the boat, and the thin yard, and refused a borrowed figure.
name: John Heminges

description: Gave the thin stair, and would not make it a motto.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Confirmed the boat, and refused a longer telling.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Reported the fields, the fourpence, and the thumb, and named no share.
name: William Shakespeare
